<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:activiti="http://activiti.org/bpmn" targetNamespace="http://activiti.org/test" id="Definitions_smokeScenario">
  <process id="smokeScenario" name="Smoke scenario" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start" />
    <sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="sum" />
    <scriptTask id="sum" name="Sum the prices" scriptFormat="javascript" activiti:resultVariable="count">
      <script>var total = 0;
for (var i = 0; i < prices.size(); i++) { total += prices.get(i); }
execution.setVariable('total', total);
prices.size();</script>
    </scriptTask>
    <sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="sum" targetRef="notify" />
    <serviceTask id="notify" name="Mail the total" activiti:type="mail">
      <extensionElements>
        <activiti:field name="to"><activiti:string>smoke@modeler.test</activiti:string></activiti:field>
        <activiti:field name="from"><activiti:string>noreply@modeler.test</activiti:string></activiti:field>
        <activiti:field name="subject"><activiti:expression>Smoke total ${total}</activiti:expression></activiti:field>
        <activiti:field name="text"><activiti:expression>The total of ${count} prices is ${total}.</activiti:expression></activiti:field>
      </extensionElements>
    </serviceTask>
    <sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="end" />
    <endEvent id="end" />
  </process>
</definitions>

scenarios.name: a JavaScript (Nashorn) script task sums the prices, a mail task sends the total to the embedded SMTP server
